name: table
description: Tabular data with a caption, column headers, and rows of text cells. Use list for a single column.

caption.description: Names the table. Required so the table is announced meaningfully.

keyboard.does: focuses the scroll region when the table is wider than the viewport

wcag.notes: Column headers use th scope=col so cells are announced with their header (1.3.1). The wrapper is a focusable named region so keyboard users can scroll wide tables (2.1.1).

machine.identify: A table element. The caption names it, thead th elements name the columns, and each tbody tr is a row.
machine.operate: Not interactive. Read cells by row and column header.
